arxiv-2104-02966.title: An almost globally convergent observer for visual SLAM without persistent excitation
arxiv-2104-02966.creator: Bowen Yi, Chi Jin, Lei Wang, Guodong Shi, Ian R. Manchester
arxiv-2104-02966.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bowen Yi, Chi Jin, Lei Wang, Guodong Shi, Ian R. Manchester. In this paper we propose a novel observer to solve the problem of visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), only using the information from a single monocular camera and an inertial measurement unit (IMU).

arxiv-2110-14049.title: Beta Shapley: a Unified and Noise-reduced Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
arxiv-2110-14049.creator: Yongchan Kwon, James Zou
arxiv-2110-14049.description: Abstract Data Shapley has recently been proposed as a principled framework to quantify the contribution of individual datum in machine learning. It can effectively identify helpful or harmful data points for a learning algorithm. In this paper, we propose Beta Shapley, which is a substantial generalization of Data Shapley.

arxiv-2401-07200.title: Exploring Compressed Image Representation as a Perceptual Proxy: A Study
arxiv-2401-07200.creator: Chen-Hsiu Huang and Ja-Ling Wu Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering, National Taiwan University No. 1, Sec. 4, Roosevelt Rd., Taipei City 106, Taiwan {chenhsiu48,wjl}@cmlab.csie.ntu.edu.tw
arxiv-2401-07200.description: Abstract We propose an end-to-end learned image compression codec wherein the analysis transform is jointly trained with an object classification task. This study affirms that the compressed latent representation can predict human perceptual distance judgments with an accuracy comparable to a custom-tailored DNN-based quality metric.

arxiv-2406-10665.title: Self-similarity of some soluble relatively free groups
arxiv-2406-10665.creator: Adilson A. Berlatto, Alex C. Dantas, Tulio M. G. Santos
arxiv-2406-10665.description: Abstract . In this paper we prove that a free nilpotent group of finite rank is transitive self-similar. In contrast, we prove that a free metabelian group of rank r ≥ 2 r\geq 2 is not transitive self-similar. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 20E08, 20B27, 20K20. 1.

arxiv-2503-01267.title: Riemann-Hilbert approach to the Algebro-Geometric solution of the modified Camassa-Holm equation with linear dispersion term
arxiv-2503-01267.creator: Engui Fan, Gaozhan Li, Yiling Yang
arxiv-2503-01267.description: Abstract . This paper aims at providing an exact algebro-geometric solution of the modified Camassa-Holm (mCH) equation derived from hyperelliptic curves in 4 ​ ( p + q ) − 1 4(p+q)-1 genus. To achieve this goal, we construct the Riemann-Hilbert problems cosponsoring to the mCH equation, which can be solved exactly by the Baker-Akhiezer function.

arxiv-2508-11687.title: Agent-Based Anti-Jamming Techniques for UAV Communications in Adversarial Environments: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2508-11687.creator: Jingpu Yang, Mingxuan Cui Hang Zhang, Fengxian Ji, Zhengzhao Lai, Yufeng Wang
arxiv-2508-11687.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicle communications are encountering increasingly severe multi-source interference challenges in dynamic adversarial environments, which impose higher demands on their reliability and resilience. To address these challenges, agent-based autonomous anti-jamming techniques have emerged as a crucial research direction.

britannica-1911-equinox.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-equinox.description: Article 'Equinox' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. term used to express either the moment at which, or the point at which, the sun apparently crosses the celestial equator. Since the sun moves in the ecliptic, it is in the last-named sense the point of intersection of the ecliptic and the celestial equator. This is the usual meaning of the term in astronomy.

This tunnel (highest point 4249 ft.) is really 17 m.

pmc-10601267.creator: Huaichang Zhong, Yaxi Zhou, Peng Wang, Qundi Jia, Yang Wan, Hai Xiong
pmc-10601267.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to provide a reference for the prevention and treatment of abnormal bone mass in postmenopausal women by analysing the current situation and influencing factors of bone mass abnormalities in Tibet.MethodsA total of 229 postmenopausal Tibetan women were randomly selected from six counties by a multistage cluster random sampling method.

pmc-10804011.title: Time to treat the climate and nature crisis as one indivisible global health emergency
pmc-10804011.creator: Chris Zielinski

pmc-11434880.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of Alternative Oxidase (AOX) Genes in Foxtail Millet (Setaria italica): Insights into Their Abiotic Stress Response
pmc-11434880.creator: Hui Zhang, Yidan Luo, Yujing Wang, Juan Zhao, Yueyue Wang, Yajun Li, Yihao Pu, Xingchun Wang, Xuemei Ren, Bo Zhao
pmc-11434880.description: Alternative oxidase (AOX) serves as a critical terminal oxidase within the plant respiratory pathway, playing a significant role in cellular responses to various stresses. Foxtail millet (Setaria italica), a crop extensively cultivated across Asia, is renowned for its remarkable tolerance to abiotic stresses and minimal requirement for fertilizer.

pmc-11456444.title: Association between adjusted body size index and abdominal aortic calcification among US older adults aged 40 years and above from a cross-sectional survey of the NHANES 2013-2014
pmc-11456444.creator: Yutong Chen, Yi Ding, Shanliang Jin, Yanwei Zhang
pmc-11456444.description: PurposeThis research aimed to assess the correlation between the Adjusted Body Shape Index (ABSI) and the presence of abdominal aortic calcification (AAC) among middle-aged and older American adults.MethodsEmploying a cross-sectional design, this study analyzed data from the 2013-2014 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), focusing on 3077 participants aged 40 and above.

pmc-11467721.title: Photocatalyst-free, visible-light-induced regio- and stereoselective synthesis of phosphorylated enamines from N-allenamides via [1,3]-sulfonyl shift at room temperature†
pmc-11467721.creator: Jia-Dong Guo, Feven-Alemu Korsaye, Dorian Schutz, Ilaria Ciofini, Laurence Miesch
pmc-11467721.description: Herein, we report the first visible-light-induced strategy for the rapid synthesis of densely functionalized α- and γ-phosphorylated β-sulfonyl enamines in a regio- and stereoselective manner from N-sulfonyl allenamides and H-phosphine oxides. The transformation displays a broad substrate scope, while operating at room temperature under photocatalyst- and additive-free conditions.

pmc-11538843.title: Impact of educational intervention and pedometer-based self-monitoring on physical activity levels in patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension
pmc-11538843.creator: Maria Wieteska-Miłek, Piotr Zieliński, Michał Florczyk, Sebastian Szmit, Bogna Rajewska, Marcin Kurzyna
pmc-11538843.description: BackgroundAppropriate levels of physical activity (PhA) provide health benefits to patients with chronic diseases, including patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). In this study, we examined the effect of physicians’ PhA recommendations on PhA, and the benefits and effectiveness of PhA self-monitoring using a pedometer for PAH patients.

pmc-11641792.title: Lifespan Extension and Motor Function Improvement Effects of Whale Meat Extract in Caenorhabditis elegans
pmc-11641792.creator: Junko Shibato, Fumiko Takenoya, Ai Kimura, Michio Yamashita, Randeep Rakwal, Seiji Shioda, Aurel Popa-Wagner
pmc-11641792.description: The average life expectancy is increasing worldwide, but the same cannot be said for a healthy life expectancy (defined as the period during which a person can live a healthy and independent life). Therefore, a major challenge is how to extend healthy life expectancy. One option is to reduce age-related muscle atrophy (sarcopenia) and cognitive decline.

pmc-12364986.title: “Comparative safety and efficacy of robotic TAPP and IPOM techniques in ventral hernia repair: a systematic review and meta-analysis of Short-term Outcomes”
pmc-12364986.creator: Ahmed Abdelsamad, Ibrahim Khalil, Khaled Ashraf Mohamed, Aya Sayed Ahmed Said Serour, Mohammed Khaled Mohammed, Noureldin Mostafa, Youssef Osama Badie, Zeyad M. Wesh, Alaeldin Mohamedsami Mohamedosman Ali, Florian Gebauer
pmc-12364986.description: BackgroundRobotic-assisted ventral hernia repair has gained popularity for its enhanced precision and visualization. Two main approaches—r-IPOM and r-TAPP—differ in technique and risk profiles. r-IPOM/+ is technically simpler and preferred for larger defects, but may increase seroma and bowel-related complications. Conversely, r-TAPP employs extraperitoneal mesh positioning, potentially reducing postoperative complications.

pmc-12643379.title: Barium Meal and Follow-up in the Diagnosis of Chronic Appendicitis in Children with Recurrent Abdominal Pain: Is the Old War Horse Still Effective?
pmc-12643379.creator: Amar Shah, Ravi Gajjar, Ria Sharma, Palak Raninga, Anirudh Shah
pmc-12643379.description: Background:Recurrent abdominal pain (RAP) in children presents a complex diagnostic challenge, with causes ranging from organic to functional and psychological. While most cases are benign, chronic appendicitis remains a rare but important consideration. Its atypical presentation and overlap with other gastrointestinal disorders make diagnosis difficult.

pmc-12798945.title: Global Mapping of Evidence on Vaccination Related Education Through School Based Curriculum
pmc-12798945.creator: Bhupender Singh Khanuja, Palak Badhwar, Kapil Singh, Shipra Verma, Anjori Agrawal, Ashwani Verma
pmc-12798945.description: BackgroundEducating school children about vaccination as a part of health promotion intervention is one of the strategies to improve vaccination acceptance. The aim of this scoping review is to describe the range of school-based education interventions related to vaccination and particularly about efforts to include such education in school curricula.

pmc-13332799.title: Fulminant Mantle Cell Lymphoma Presenting With Hepatic Infiltration and Spontaneous Tumor Lysis Syndrome
pmc-13332799.creator: Shyamal Sheth, Amer Alsamman
pmc-13332799.description: Mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) is an uncommon, aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that typically presents with lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, and gastrointestinal (GI) tract involvement, most often as multiple lymphomatous polyps. While hepatic involvement by MCL is rare and usually asymptomatic, hepatic lesions in clinical practice more often represent metastases from GI, breast, lung, or pancreatic primaries.
